fields.block_hint_0x810: value read by the slow window; shifted right by 2 for the big-path guard and passed as the block callee's second argument
fields.big_counter_0x8b8: incremented by 1 on the slow window's big path before the tail jump
fields.end_0x8c0: written by the slow window's install: block start plus hint when consume is set, block start plus remaining otherwise
fields.cursor_0x8c8: bump cursor read and written by the main window's fast path; written by the slow window's install
fields.remaining_0x8d0: remaining space read by the main window's fast path; set to hint minus size by the slow window's install
fields.gate_0x8d8: gate tested by the main window (zero takes the fast path) and passed as the grow callee's second argument by the slow window

main_behavior.grow_route: gate nonzero AND quantum nonzero AND size nonzero: rounded = ((size - 1) // quantum + 1) * quantum; block = grow(object, rounded) via 0x605d000; nonzero block is returned at once with no cursor update
main_behavior.grow_failure: grow result zero: errno string built via 0x61d1f30, reported via 0x5fceda0, heap temporary freed with sized delete of size (field at +0x10) + 1 unless the data pointer equals the object's +0x10 buffer, then the fast path runs
main_behavior.fast_route: gate zero OR quantum zero OR size zero, or after a failed grow: pad = (16 - (cursor & 0xf)) % 16; needed = size + pad; remaining < needed tail-jumps to the slow window with consume 1, else cursor += needed, remaining -= needed, return cursor_before + pad
main_behavior.landing_pad: 0x605d91a disposes the temporary string (stub 0x605d786: _M_dispose on the string at rsp, then _Unwind_Resume) when unwinding through the error-report region

slow_behavior.big_route: size > (block hint >> 2): big counter (+0x8b8) += 1, then tail-jump to the block callee 0x605d3c0 with (object, size); its return is the result and no fields are installed
slow_behavior.grow_route: gate nonzero: block = grow(object, gate) via 0x605d000; nonzero block installs with hint = gate; zero block reloads the block hint and falls through to the block callee
slow_behavior.block_route: gate zero, or grow returned zero: block = block_callee(object, block hint) via 0x605d3c0; installs with hint = block hint
slow_behavior.install: remaining = hint - size; consume set: cursor = block + size, end = block + hint; consume clear: cursor = block, end = block + remaining; return value is the block start in both arms

report.logger: fourth argument of the main window (rcx on entry)
report.format: [%s:119] AllocateAligned fail to allocate huge TLB pages: %s
report.detail: data of the temporary error string built from errno

member_vtable_0x64d1fb8.note: the main window is the fourth virtual (slot 0x64d1fd0) of the member class whose destroy is 0x605cc30, mapped by the destructor-pair packet

main.note: the qword hit is the addend field of the RELATIVE entry for slot 0x64d1fd0, not a separate reference; the 0x5f11xxx sites are the two destructor-pair-class virtuals, the other four callers' internals were not read

slow.note: 0x605d88d is the main window's slow path; 0x605d962 is inside the neighbouring member virtual 0x605d930, which tail-jumps to the slow window at its end
